create_Minitaur_instance: create a Minitaur quadruped robot simulation instance with pybullet client and configurable motor control modes
reset_Minitaur_pose: reset the Minitaur robot to its initial position and orientation with optional joint constraints
apply_action_Minitaur: apply motor angle commands to the Minitaur robot using PD control or torque control
get_observation_Minitaur: get the Minitaur robot observation including motor angles, velocities, torques, and base orientation
set_foot_friction_Minitaur: set the lateral friction coefficient for all four feet of the Minitaur robot
